linguistics.en: Students of linguistics examine how languages change over long periods of time.
linguistics.zh: 学习语言学的学生研究语言如何长期演变。

linguist.en: The linguist spent ten years recording the speech of older villagers.
linguist.zh: 这位语言学家花了十年时间记录老年村民的话语。

linguistic.en: Linguistic differences between the two regions have grown over the past century.
linguistic.zh: 过去一个世纪,这两个地区的语言差异越来越大。

vocabulary.en: Children who read often tend to have a much larger vocabulary.
vocabulary.zh: 经常阅读的孩子往往词汇量更大。

grammar.en: The grammar of the language is quite simple, but its sounds are difficult.
grammar.zh: 这种语言的语法相当简单,但发音很难。

syntax.en: The syntax of English has changed relatively little in the past few centuries.
syntax.zh: 过去几个世纪,英语的句法变化相对较小。

semantic.en: Semantic changes mean that some words now have the opposite of their original meaning.
semantic.zh: 语义的变化意味着一些词现在的含义与原义相反。

phonetics.en: Phonetics is the study of how the sounds of speech are produced.
phonetics.zh: 语音学研究语音是如何发出的。

pronunciation.en: The pronunciation of many English words has changed since Shakespeare's time.
pronunciation.zh: 自莎士比亚时代以来,许多英语单词的发音都发生了变化。

accent.en: Listeners often make quick judgements about people based on their accent.
accent.zh: 听者常常根据口音对人作出快速判断。

dialect.en: Each valley in the region once had its own distinct dialect.
dialect.zh: 该地区的每个山谷都曾有自己独特的方言。

mother-tongue.en: Children usually learn to read more easily in their mother tongue.
mother-tongue.zh: 孩子通常用母语学习阅读更容易。

native-speaker.en: Even a native speaker may find this ancient text hard to understand.
native-speaker.zh: 即使是母语者,也可能觉得这篇古文难以理解。

bilingual.en: Bilingual children can often switch between languages with little effort.
bilingual.zh: 双语儿童常常能毫不费力地在两种语言之间切换。

multilingual.en: In this multilingual society, most people use at least three languages daily.
multilingual.zh: 在这个多语社会中,大多数人每天至少使用三种语言。

fluent.en: It usually takes several years to become fluent in a foreign language.
fluent.zh: 要流利地掌握一门外语,通常需要好几年。

fluency.en: Regular conversation with others is the best way to develop fluency.
fluency.zh: 经常与人交谈是提高流利度的最好方法。

literacy.en: Rates of literacy rose quickly after free schools were introduced.
literacy.zh: 免费学校推行后,识字率迅速上升。

illiterate.en: In the Middle Ages, most ordinary people in Europe were illiterate.
illiterate.zh: 中世纪时,欧洲大多数普通人都是文盲。

alphabet.en: The modern English alphabet developed from a much older Roman one.
alphabet.zh: 现代英语字母表由更古老的罗马字母发展而来。

script.en: The ancient script has never been fully understood by modern scholars.
script.zh: 现代学者从未完全读懂这种古代文字。

script.en: The actor forgot part of the script during the first performance.
script.zh: 首场演出时,这位演员忘了部分剧本。

symbol.en: Early farmers used a simple symbol to represent each type of grain.
symbol.zh: 早期农民用简单的符号表示每种谷物。

gesture.en: A simple gesture can have very different meanings in different cultures.
gesture.zh: 一个简单的手势在不同文化中可能有截然不同的含义。

sign-language.en: Deaf children learn sign language as naturally as others learn to speak.
sign-language.zh: 聋儿学习手语就像其他孩子学说话一样自然。

acquisition.en: The acquisition of a first language happens without formal teaching.
acquisition.zh: 第一语言的习得不需要正规教学。

acquisition.en: The company's acquisition of a smaller rival made it the largest in Europe.
acquisition.zh: 这家公司收购了一家较小的竞争对手,成为欧洲最大的公司。

translate.en: Some poems are almost impossible to translate into another language.
translate.zh: 有些诗歌几乎无法翻译成另一种语言。

translation.en: An English translation of the text appeared more than a century later.
translation.zh: 这篇文本的英译本在一个多世纪后才问世。

interpreter.en: An interpreter was needed for the meeting between the two leaders.
interpreter.zh: 两国领导人会晤时需要一名口译员。

verbal.en: Verbal skills develop rapidly between the ages of two and five.
verbal.zh: 语言能力在两岁到五岁之间迅速发展。

non-verbal.en: Non-verbal communication includes facial expressions and the way people stand.
non-verbal.zh: 非言语交流包括面部表情和人们的站姿。

oral.en: These stories were passed down through oral tradition for many generations.
oral.zh: 这些故事通过口头传统流传了许多代。

written.en: No written records of the language survive from before the tenth century.
written.zh: 这种语言没有十世纪以前的书面记录留存下来。

idiom.en: Learners often find it difficult to understand an idiom such as 'break the ice'.
idiom.zh: 学习者常常觉得 “break the ice” 这样的习语很难理解。

etymology.en: The etymology of the word shows that it came from ancient Greek.
etymology.zh: 这个词的词源显示它来自古希腊语。

endangered-language.en: Researchers are making recordings of each endangered language before it disappears.
endangered-language.zh: 研究者正在为每种濒危语言录音,以防它们消失。

lingua-franca.en: Latin served as a lingua franca for educated people across Europe.
lingua-franca.zh: 拉丁语曾是欧洲各地受教育者的通用语。

phonology.en: The phonology of the language includes several sounds not found in English.
phonology.zh: 这种语言的音系包括几种英语中没有的音。

tense.en: Some languages have no verb forms to show past or future tense.
tense.zh: 有些语言没有表示过去或将来时态的动词形式。

tense.en: Relations between the two countries remained tense for several years.
tense.zh: 两国关系多年来一直紧张。

verse.en: Many early histories were written in verse so that they could be remembered.
verse.zh: 许多早期历史用韵文写成,以便记忆。

fable.en: The ancient fable teaches children the value of hard work.
fable.zh: 这则古老的寓言教导孩子们勤劳的价值。

maxim.en: The old maxim that practice makes perfect has some scientific support.
maxim.zh: “熟能生巧”这句老格言有一定的科学依据。

adage.en: According to an old adage, a picture is worth a thousand words.
adage.zh: 有句古老的谚语说,一图胜千言。

satire.en: The novel is a clever satire on the politics of the period.
satire.zh: 这部小说是对当时政治的巧妙讽刺。

farce.en: The play is a farce about a family who keep losing their money.
farce.zh: 这部戏是一出闹剧,讲的是一个总是丢钱的家庭。

pictograph.en: A pictograph uses a simple picture to represent an object or an idea.
pictograph.zh: 象形文字用简单的图画表示物体或概念。

abstraction.en: Mathematics requires a high level of abstraction from everyday experience.
abstraction.zh: 数学需要从日常经验中进行高度抽象。

coin.en: Writers often coin new words to describe recent technologies.
coin.zh: 作家常常创造新词来描述新技术。

coin.en: A Roman coin was found among the remains of the old house.
coin.zh: 在这座老房子的遗迹中发现了一枚罗马硬币。

cogent.en: The report presents a cogent argument for reforming the education system.
cogent.zh: 这份报告为改革教育体系提出了令人信服的论证。

persuasive.en: The speaker gave a persuasive account of the benefits of learning languages.
persuasive.zh: 演讲者很有说服力地阐述了学习语言的好处。

orator.en: Cicero was a famous Roman orator whose speeches are still studied today.
orator.zh: 西塞罗是著名的罗马演说家,他的演讲至今仍有人研究。

discourse.en: Scientific discourse has become increasingly dominated by the English language.
discourse.zh: 科学话语越来越被英语主导。

rhetoric.en: Students in ancient Greece studied rhetoric to prepare for public life.
rhetoric.zh: 古希腊的学生学习修辞,为公共生活做准备。

metaphor.en: The author uses the metaphor of a journey to describe language learning.
metaphor.zh: 作者用旅程这一隐喻来描述语言学习。

usage.en: The usage of this word has changed greatly over the past fifty years.
usage.zh: 过去五十年,这个词的用法发生了很大变化。

articulate.en: Young children may struggle to articulate their feelings clearly.
articulate.zh: 幼儿可能难以清楚表达自己的感受。

articulate.en: She was an articulate speaker who could explain difficult ideas simply.
articulate.zh: 她善于表达,能把难懂的观点解释得很简单。

utterance.en: A child's first utterance usually consists of just a single word.
utterance.zh: 孩子最初的话语通常只有一个词。

lexical.en: The study compared lexical differences between British and American English.
lexical.zh: 这项研究比较了英式英语和美式英语的词汇差异。

grammatical.en: Young children make grammatical errors that follow surprisingly regular patterns.
grammatical.zh: 幼儿犯的语法错误遵循着惊人的规律。

denote.en: Different colours on the map denote different language families.
denote.zh: 地图上不同的颜色表示不同的语系。

syllable.en: Japanese words are built from short units that are similar to a syllable.
syllable.zh: 日语单词由类似音节的短单位构成。

syntactic.en: Syntactic rules determine the order of words in a sentence.
syntactic.zh: 句法规则决定句子中的词序。

transcription.en: The transcription of the interviews took the researchers several months.
transcription.zh: 研究者花了几个月才把访谈转写完。

vowel.en: Hawaiian has only five vowels and a small number of other sounds.
vowel.zh: 夏威夷语只有五个元音和少量其他音。

corpus.en: Researchers used a large corpus of newspaper texts to study word frequency.
corpus.zh: 研究者利用大型报纸语料库研究词频。

derivative.en: The word 'happiness' is a derivative of the adjective 'happy'.
derivative.zh: “happiness” 一词是形容词 “happy” 的派生词。

singular.en: Some nouns have the same form in the singular as in the plural.
singular.zh: 有些名词的单数和复数形式相同。

transcribe.en: Monks spent years transcribing old books by hand in the Middle Ages.
transcribe.zh: 中世纪时,修道士花费多年时间手抄古书。

connotation.en: The word 'cheap' often has a negative connotation for English speakers.
connotation.zh: 对说英语的人来说,“cheap” 一词往往带有负面的含义。

comma.en: A misplaced comma can sometimes change the meaning of a legal document.
comma.zh: 一个放错位置的逗号有时会改变法律文件的含义。

consonant.en: Some languages have long groups of consonants that are hard to pronounce.
consonant.zh: 有些语言有一长串难以发音的辅音。

plural.en: In some languages, the plural is shown by repeating the word.
plural.zh: 在一些语言中,复数通过重复单词来表示。

unintelligible.en: Old English is now unintelligible to most modern speakers.
unintelligible.zh: 现代大多数说英语的人已经无法理解古英语。

descriptor.en: The test uses a clear descriptor for each level of ability.
descriptor.zh: 这项测试对每个能力水平都有明确的描述词。

narrative.en: The early chapters provide a clear narrative of the voyage.
narrative.zh: 开头几章对这次航行作了清晰的叙述。

narrator.en: The narrator of the novel is a young girl living in the countryside.
narrator.zh: 这部小说的叙述者是住在乡下的小女孩。

tone.en: The tone of the letter suggests that the author was deeply worried.
tone.zh: 这封信的语气表明作者非常担忧。

archaeology.en: Advances in archaeology have changed our view of how early towns developed.
archaeology.zh: 考古学的进步改变了我们对早期城镇发展的看法。

archaeologist.en: An archaeologist discovered the remains of a Roman villa beneath the farm.
archaeologist.zh: 一位考古学家在农场下面发现了一座罗马别墅的遗迹。

excavate.en: Teams from three universities will excavate the site next summer.
excavate.zh: 三所大学的团队明年夏天将发掘这处遗址。

excavation.en: Excavation of the ancient city began in the early twentieth century.
excavation.zh: 这座古城的发掘始于二十世纪初。

artefact.en: Each artefact was carefully cleaned and photographed before being moved.
artefact.zh: 每件人工制品在移动前都经过仔细清理和拍照。

relic.en: The old stone bridge is a relic of the town's Roman past.
relic.zh: 这座古石桥是该镇罗马时代的遗物。

remains.en: The remains of an ancient ship were found beneath the river mud.
remains.zh: 在河底的淤泥下发现了一艘古船的遗骸。

ruins.en: Tourists come from around the world to visit the ruins of the temple.
ruins.zh: 游客从世界各地前来参观神庙的废墟。

site.en: Archaeologists found thousands of stone tools at the site.
site.zh: 考古学家在这处遗址发现了数千件石器。

tomb.en: The tomb contained gold jewellery and food for the next life.
tomb.zh: 墓中有金首饰和为来世准备的食物。

pyramid.en: Thousands of workers were needed to build each pyramid in Egypt.
pyramid.zh: 在埃及,建造每座金字塔都需要数千名工人。

inscription.en: An inscription on the stone records the name of the local ruler.
inscription.zh: 石头上的铭文记录了当地统治者的名字。

hieroglyph.en: Each hieroglyph could represent either a sound or a complete idea.
hieroglyph.zh: 每个象形文字既可以表示一个音,也可以表示一个完整的概念。

carbon-dating.en: Carbon dating showed that the wooden tools were about six thousand years old.
carbon-dating.zh: 碳定年显示这些木制工具约有六千年历史。

prehistoric.en: Prehistoric people painted animals on the walls of the caves.
prehistoric.zh: 史前人类在洞穴的墙壁上画动物。

stone-age.en: People in the Stone Age made sharp tools from a type of hard rock.
stone-age.zh: 石器时代的人用一种坚硬的岩石制作锋利的工具。

bronze-age.en: Trade across the region grew rapidly during the Bronze Age.
bronze-age.zh: 青铜时代,这一地区的贸易迅速发展。

iron-age.en: Iron Age farmers built round houses from wood and dried mud.
iron-age.zh: 铁器时代的农民用木头和干泥建造圆屋。

medieval.en: The medieval town still has its original walls and narrow streets.
medieval.zh: 这座中世纪小镇仍保留着原有的城墙和狭窄的街道。

ancient.en: Ancient Egyptians used papyrus plants to make an early type of paper.
ancient.zh: 古埃及人用纸莎草制造一种早期的纸。

antique.en: The museum bought the antique clock from a private collector.
antique.zh: 博物馆从一位私人收藏家手中买下了这座古董钟。

civilisation.en: The Maya civilisation developed a sophisticated calendar and system of writing.
civilisation.zh: 玛雅文明发展出了精密的历法和文字系统。

dynasty.en: The dynasty ruled the country for more than three hundred years.
dynasty.zh: 这个朝代统治该国三百多年。

empire.en: At its height, the Roman Empire stretched from Britain to Egypt.
empire.zh: 罗马帝国全盛时期从不列颠延伸到埃及。

emperor.en: The emperor ordered the construction of a great wall along the border.
emperor.zh: 皇帝下令沿边境修建一道长城。

monarch.en: Queen Victoria was one of the longest-reigning monarchs in British history.
monarch.zh: 维多利亚女王是英国历史上在位时间最长的君主之一。

monarchy.en: The monarchy lost most of its political power during the nineteenth century.
monarchy.zh: 十九世纪,君主制失去了大部分政治权力。

reign.en: Trade and the arts flourished during the reign of the young queen.
reign.zh: 在这位年轻女王统治期间,贸易和艺术蓬勃发展。

reign.en: The king reigned for over fifty years and left a stable country.
reign.zh: 这位国王统治了五十多年,留下了一个稳定的国家。

kingdom.en: The small kingdom grew wealthy by controlling trade on the river.
kingdom.zh: 这个小王国通过控制河上贸易而富裕起来。

aristocracy.en: Land ownership allowed the aristocracy to keep its political power for centuries.
aristocracy.zh: 贵族阶层凭借土地所有权,掌握政治权力长达数百年。

peasant.en: The average peasant worked long hours and owned very little land.
peasant.zh: 普通农民工作时间很长,拥有的土地却很少。

slavery.en: Slavery was finally abolished in the British Empire in the 1830s.
slavery.zh: 19 世纪 30 年代,大英帝国终于废除了奴隶制。

tribe.en: Each tribe in the region had its own customs and leaders.
tribe.zh: 该地区的每个部落都有自己的习俗和首领。

indigenous.en: Indigenous peoples have lived on this land for thousands of years.
indigenous.zh: 本土民族在这片土地上生活了数千年。

aboriginal.en: Aboriginal Australians have one of the oldest continuous cultures in the world.
aboriginal.zh: 澳大利亚土著拥有世界上最古老的延续文化之一。

settlement.en: The first settlement in the valley was founded around 4000 BC.
settlement.zh: 山谷中最早的定居点约建于公元前 4000 年。

settlement.en: The two countries reached a peaceful settlement of the border dispute.
settlement.zh: 两国和平解决了边界争端。

settler.en: European settlers brought new crops and diseases to the continent.
settler.zh: 欧洲定居者把新作物和疾病带到了这片大陆。

colonise.en: European powers began to colonise large parts of Africa in the 1880s.
colonise.zh: 19 世纪 80 年代,欧洲列强开始殖民非洲的大片地区。

conquest.en: The Norman conquest of 1066 brought thousands of French words into English.
conquest.zh: 1066 年的诺曼征服把成千上万的法语词带入了英语。

invade.en: The Vikings began to invade the coast of Britain in the eighth century.
invade.zh: 维京人从八世纪起开始入侵不列颠海岸。

revolution.en: The French Revolution changed the political map of Europe.
revolution.zh: 法国大革命改变了欧洲的政治版图。

industrial-revolution.en: The Industrial Revolution brought millions of people from the country to the cities.
industrial-revolution.zh: 工业革命使数百万人从乡村来到城市。

renaissance.en: The Renaissance began in Italy and spread across much of Europe.
renaissance.zh: 文艺复兴始于意大利,并传播到欧洲大部分地区。

heritage.en: The old town is an important part of the country's cultural heritage.
heritage.zh: 这座老城是该国文化遗产的重要组成部分。

legacy.en: The roads built by the Romans are a lasting legacy of their empire.
legacy.zh: 罗马人修建的道路是其帝国留下的长久遗产。

chronicle.en: A monk wrote a detailed chronicle of events during the king's reign.
chronicle.zh: 一位修道士详细记录了国王统治时期的事件,写成编年史。

chronological.en: The objects are displayed in chronological order, from oldest to newest.
chronological.zh: 这些物品按时间顺序展出,从最古老的到最新的。

era.en: The arrival of the railway marked the beginning of a new era.
era.zh: 铁路的到来标志着一个新时代的开始。

epoch.en: The fossils date from an epoch when the climate was much warmer.
epoch.zh: 这些化石来自气候温暖得多的一个纪元。

descend.en: Modern English is thought to descend from a language spoken in northern Germany.
descend.zh: 人们认为现代英语传自德国北部使用的一种语言。

origin.en: The origin of the custom is still a matter of debate among historians.
origin.zh: 这个习俗的起源至今仍是历史学家争论的问题。

myth.en: The myth tells how the first people came to live on the island.
myth.zh: 这个神话讲述了最早的人类如何来到岛上生活。

legend.en: According to legend, the city was founded by two brothers.
legend.zh: 据传说,这座城市是由两兄弟建立的。

ritual.en: The ritual is performed each spring to ensure a good harvest.
ritual.zh: 每年春天都举行这种仪式,以祈求丰收。

ceremony.en: The new king was crowned in a long ceremony at the cathedral.
ceremony.zh: 新国王在大教堂举行的漫长典礼上加冕。

worship.en: Ancient people often worshipped the sun as the source of life.
worship.zh: 古人常常把太阳当作生命之源来崇拜。

sacred.en: The mountain is sacred to the people who live around it.
sacred.zh: 这座山对周围的居民来说是神圣的。

nomad.en: Each nomad family moved its animals to new grass with the seasons.
nomad.zh: 每个游牧家庭都随季节把牲畜迁到新的草场。

nomadic.en: Nomadic people often travelled long distances in search of food for their animals.
nomadic.zh: 游牧民族常常长途跋涉,为牲畜寻找食物。

hunter-gatherer.en: A hunter-gatherer society depends on wild animals and plants for food.
hunter-gatherer.zh: 狩猎采集社会依靠野生动植物获取食物。

unearth.en: Farmers often unearth Roman coins while ploughing their fields.
unearth.zh: 农民在犁田时经常挖出罗马硬币。

petrify.en: Over millions of years, minerals can petrify the wood of fallen trees.
petrify.zh: 数百万年间,矿物质能使倒下的树木石化。

skull.en: The shape of the skull suggests that this person lived on a hard diet.
skull.zh: 头骨的形状表明此人的饮食较硬。

hominid.en: The bones belong to an early hominid that lived about three million years ago.
hominid.zh: 这些骨头属于约三百万年前的一种早期原始人类。

primitive.en: The first boats were primitive structures made from hollow logs.
primitive.zh: 最早的船是用空心原木做成的简陋结构。

archaic.en: The legal document was written in an archaic form of the language.
archaic.zh: 这份法律文件是用这种语言的古老形式写成的。

remnant.en: The small forest is a remnant of the woodland that once covered the country.
remnant.zh: 这片小森林是曾经覆盖全国的林地的残余。

antiquity.en: The city has been an important centre of trade since antiquity.
antiquity.zh: 这座城市自古代起就是重要的贸易中心。

neolithic.en: Neolithic farmers cleared the forests and began to grow crops here.
neolithic.zh: 新石器时代的农民在这里清除森林,开始种植庄稼。

paleolithic.en: Paleolithic people lived in small groups and made tools from stone.
paleolithic.zh: 旧石器时代的人小群体生活,用石头制作工具。

anthropologist.en: The anthropologist lived with the tribe for two years to study their customs.
anthropologist.zh: 这位人类学家与部落一起生活了两年,研究他们的习俗。

posterity.en: These recordings were made to preserve the language for posterity.
posterity.zh: 这些录音是为了给后代保存这种语言。

forefather.en: Local people still use the farming methods of their forefathers.
forefather.zh: 当地人仍在使用祖先的耕作方法。

clan.en: Each clan in the Scottish Highlands had its own leader and land.
clan.zh: 苏格兰高地的每个宗族都有自己的首领和土地。

patriarchal.en: In patriarchal societies, property usually passes from father to son.
patriarchal.zh: 在父权制社会中,财产通常由父亲传给儿子。

enslave.en: Invaders would often enslave the people of the towns they captured.
enslave.zh: 入侵者常常奴役被他们占领的城镇的居民。

abdicate.en: The king was forced to abdicate after he lost the support of the army.
abdicate.zh: 失去军队支持后,国王被迫退位。

palace.en: The palace was built with marble brought from far across the empire.
palace.zh: 这座宫殿用从帝国遥远地区运来的大理石建造。

temple.en: The temple stands on a hill and can be seen from miles away.
temple.zh: 寺庙矗立在山上,几英里外都能看到。

cathedral.en: It took nearly two hundred years to complete the great cathedral.
cathedral.zh: 这座宏伟的大教堂花了近两百年才建成。

spire.en: The cathedral's tall spire can be seen from anywhere in the city.
spire.zh: 从城里任何地方都能看到大教堂高耸的尖塔。

fort.en: The Romans built a fort here to protect the crossing of the river.
fort.zh: 罗马人在这里修建了一座堡垒,以保护渡河口。

siege.en: The city survived a siege lasting more than two years.
siege.zh: 这座城市在长达两年多的围攻中幸存了下来。

expedition.en: The expedition to the South Pole was hit by terrible weather.
expedition.zh: 前往南极的探险遭遇了恶劣的天气。

armour.en: Metal armour protected knights in battle but made movement difficult.
armour.zh: 金属盔甲在战斗中保护骑士,但也使行动不便。

religion.en: Religion played a central part in the daily life of medieval people.
religion.zh: 宗教在中世纪人们的日常生活中占据核心地位。

buddhism.en: Buddhism spread from India to China along the old trade routes.
buddhism.zh: 佛教沿着古老的贸易路线从印度传到中国。

taoism.en: Taoism teaches that people should live in harmony with the natural world.
taoism.zh: 道教主张人应与自然和谐相处。

christianity.en: Christianity spread rapidly through the Roman Empire after the fourth century.
christianity.zh: 四世纪后,基督教在罗马帝国迅速传播。

atheism.en: The book traces the growth of atheism in nineteenth-century Europe.
atheism.zh: 这本书追溯了十九世纪欧洲无神论的发展。

creed.en: People of every race and creed were welcome in the port city.
creed.zh: 这座港口城市欢迎各个种族和信条的人。

doctrine.en: The church's doctrine had a strong influence on medieval science.
doctrine.zh: 教会的教义对中世纪科学产生了强烈影响。

dogma.en: Scientists should be careful not to treat a popular theory as dogma.
dogma.zh: 科学家应小心不要把流行的理论当成教条。

heresy.en: In the past, people could be punished severely for heresy.
heresy.zh: 过去,人们可能因异端而受到严厉惩罚。

cult.en: The sun was the centre of an important religious cult in ancient Egypt.
cult.zh: 太阳是古埃及一种重要宗教崇拜的中心。

devout.en: The king was a devout man who built many churches during his reign.
devout.zh: 这位国王很虔诚,在位期间建造了许多教堂。

preach.en: Travelling monks would preach to people in towns along the road.
preach.zh: 云游的修道士会向沿途城镇的人布道。

prophet.en: The prophet is said to have warned the people about the coming flood.
prophet.zh: 据说这位先知曾警告人们洪水即将来临。

destiny.en: Many ancient people believed that the stars controlled human destiny.
destiny.zh: 许多古人相信星辰掌控着人类的命运。

taboo.en: In some cultures, there is a strict taboo against eating certain animals.
taboo.zh: 在一些文化中,吃某些动物有严格的禁忌。

rite.en: The rite marks the moment when a young person becomes an adult.
rite.zh: 这一仪式标志着年轻人成年的时刻。

ghost.en: Many old stories tell of the ghost of a king who haunts the castle.
ghost.zh: 许多古老的故事讲述一位国王的鬼魂在城堡中出没。

invasion.en: The invasion of 1066 changed the course of English history.
invasion.zh: 1066 年的入侵改变了英国历史的进程。

sword.en: Only wealthy warriors could afford a sword made from good steel.
sword.zh: 只有富有的武士才买得起优质钢制成的剑。

reconstruct.en: Scientists used the bones to reconstruct the appearance of the animal.
reconstruct.zh: 科学家用这些骨头重构了这种动物的外貌。

scroll.en: Ancient texts were often written on a long scroll of paper.
scroll.zh: 古代文本常常写在长长的纸质卷轴上。

circa.en: The palace was built circa 1500 BC, according to the archaeologists.
circa.zh: 据考古学家说,这座宫殿约建于公元前 1500 年。

crown.en: The crown passed to the king's younger brother after his death.
crown.zh: 国王死后,王权传给了他的弟弟。

imperial.en: The imperial court employed thousands of officials and servants.
imperial.zh: 皇室朝廷雇用了数千名官员和仆人。

chapel.en: The small chapel on the island was built by monks in the seventh century.
chapel.zh: 岛上这座小教堂是七世纪时修道士建造的。

spiritual.en: Mountains had a deep spiritual meaning for many ancient cultures.
spiritual.zh: 高山对许多古代文化有着深刻的精神意义。

miracle.en: Local people considered the survival of the whole crew a miracle.
miracle.zh: 当地人认为全体船员幸存下来是个奇迹。

divine.en: Kings once claimed that their power had a divine origin.
divine.zh: 国王们曾声称他们的权力来自神。

triumph.en: The opening of the canal was a triumph of nineteenth-century engineering.
triumph.zh: 运河的开通是十九世纪工程学的一次胜利。

combat.en: Knights trained from childhood to prepare for combat on horseback.
combat.zh: 骑士从小接受训练,为骑马作战做准备。

combat.en: New laws were passed to combat corruption in the government.
combat.zh: 新法律的出台是为了打击政府腐败。

defeat.en: The defeat of the army led to the end of the empire.
defeat.zh: 军队的失败导致了帝国的终结。

defeat.en: The small kingdom managed to defeat a much larger invading force.
defeat.zh: 这个小王国成功击败了规模大得多的入侵军队。

fleet.en: A great fleet of ships carried soldiers across the Mediterranean.
fleet.zh: 一支庞大的舰队载着士兵穿越地中海。

artillery.en: Heavy artillery could destroy the old stone walls of a castle.
artillery.zh: 重型火炮能摧毁城堡古老的石墙。

ammunition.en: The army ran out of ammunition after a month of fighting.
ammunition.zh: 经过一个月的战斗,军队的弹药用完了。

shield.en: Each soldier carried a round shield made of wood and leather.
shield.zh: 每个士兵都拿着一面用木头和皮革制成的圆盾。

shield.en: Thick walls were designed to shield the town from attack.
shield.zh: 厚厚的城墙是为了保护小镇免受攻击。

exile.en: The former leader lived in exile for the rest of his life.
exile.zh: 这位前领导人的余生都在流亡中度过。

nobility.en: Members of the nobility paid almost no taxes before the revolution.
nobility.zh: 革命前,贵族成员几乎不用缴税。

millennium.en: The town has been a centre of trade for more than a millennium.
millennium.zh: 一千多年来,这座城镇一直是贸易中心。

revolt.en: Peasants rose in revolt against the high taxes demanded by the king.
revolt.zh: 农民起义反抗国王征收的重税。

massacre.en: The massacre of the villagers caused anger across the whole country.
massacre.zh: 对村民的大屠杀引起了全国的愤怒。

assassination.en: The assassination of the archduke in 1914 helped to start the First World War.
assassination.zh: 1914 年大公遇刺促成了第一次世界大战的爆发。

curse.en: According to popular stories, a curse protected the tomb from thieves.
curse.zh: 根据民间传说,诅咒保护着这座陵墓免遭盗窃。

cannon.en: The new cannon could fire heavy stone balls over great distances.
cannon.zh: 这种新式大炮能把沉重的石弹射得很远。

burial.en: Gold and weapons were placed in the burial chamber of the king.
burial.zh: 黄金和武器被放在国王的墓室里。

cemetery.en: The old cemetery contains the graves of many early settlers.
cemetery.zh: 这座老墓地里有许多早期定居者的坟墓。

mosaic.en: A beautiful Roman mosaic was discovered beneath the floor of the old church.
mosaic.zh: 在老教堂的地板下发现了一幅精美的罗马马赛克镶嵌画。
